title: Outer Dublin's Hidden Strength: Why D15, D18 & D24 Beat Inner-City Over-Asking Premiums
excerpt: Outer Dublin suburbs (D15, D18, D24) sustain equal or higher over-asking premiums than D4/D3 while trading 30-40% cheaper. Remote work and first-time buyer dominance have triggered a permanent market inversion—and it's actionable.
author: Market Research Team
